environment: Node deterministic Web Locks simulation; browser tests recorded separately

checks.name: Stale reading-position save retains another tab’s newer reflection
Queued different-note saves preserve both notes without last-writer loss
Concurrent bookmark additions merge; stale reading cannot resurrect removed bookmark
Stale background save preserves theme, size and explicit preference changes
Intentional empty reflection stays empty after a stale tab saves
Second editor is refused; closing first editor releases ownership
Import cannot overwrite a reflection being edited in another tab
Import after editor closes merges, and stale writer retains imported reflection
Future and damaged records are never overwritten by background persistence
Quota error preserves stored data and rejects save
No Web Locks means no unsafe writes or editor permission
Existing three-record export/import format still includes merged saved learning
